title: Derivative identities for a unit curve parametrized by its angle
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, all vectors u, e ∈ ℝ^P, every real s and every γ : ℝ → ℝ^P that is C¹ on (−s, s) and satisfies ‖γ(α)‖ = 1, ⟨γ(α), u⟩ > 0 and arctan(⟨γ(α), e⟩/⟨γ(α), u⟩) = α for every α ∈ (−s, s): for every α ∈ (−s, s), with γ′(α) := deriv γ α, ⟨γ(α), γ′(α)⟩ = 0, ⟨γ(α),u⟩⟨γ′(α),e⟩ − ⟨γ(α),e⟩⟨γ′(α),u⟩ = ⟨γ(α),u⟩² + ⟨γ(α),e⟩², and γ′(α) ≠ 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u e : Euclid P) (s : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-s) s) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ 0 < inner ℝ (γ α) u ∧ Real.arctan (inner ℝ (γ α) e / inner ℝ (γ α) u) = α) → ∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, inner ℝ (γ α) (deriv γ α) = 0 ∧ inner ℝ (γ α) u * inner ℝ (deriv γ α) e - inner ℝ (γ α) e * inner ℝ (deriv γ α) u = inner ℝ (γ α) u ^ 2 + inner ℝ (γ α) e ^ 2 ∧ deriv γ α ≠ 0
